scope: Current unbounded Newtonian liquid model,not a calibrated Petri-dish environment

preview_velocity.source: Rounded/subsampled true-world preview vertices,not complete raw trajectory or fluid velocity

findings: Leading-order local RFT Newtonian model,dimensioned force/torque balance;not full CFD.
No explicit walls/free surfaces,nonlocal interactions,body taper,self-contact or non-Newtonian rheology.
Fixed drag wavelength parameter does not follow learned spatial waveform.
Muscle moment/preferred-curvature scale is modeling closure,not directly calibrated muscle force.
No end-to-end benchmark against observed thrust/speed/waveform or spatial-resolution convergence established.
Current channel-body branch has no body-to-brain feedback;medium changes do not directly adapt neural rhythm.
limitations: Velocity estimates use preview sampling,not peak fluid velocity or inertial-error bounds.
Low local Re supports an overdamped approximation,not proof of quantitative hydrodynamic accuracy.
No dynamics or fitted checkpoint changed.
